title: Relationen vom russischen Hof: Berichte europäischer Diplomaten, 1690-1730
institution: Deutsches Historisches Institut Moskau (editors Lorenz Erren and Franziska Schedewie)
notes: Transcriptions of reports and letters from the Russian court sent to the imperial court in Vienna and to Berlin. Of 660 transcribed documents, 34 date from 1690-95 (per the introduction); the rest are from 1726-1728 and fall outside the period. 37 transcribed documents are dated or filed 1690-1696. The whole edition lists 1,242 items, of which 660 have transcripts. The document index was last modified on 5 July 2018 and the introduction is dated 2016; the project (funded 2012-2015) is a pilot that was not continued. Texts are served as HTML with RDFa; no download of the texts was found. Corpus statistics (text and word counts) derived from the Renascor Corpus snapshot v2026.10 (texts harvested from this resource in October 2026, duplicates included; they may cover only part of it).
